comparative_reference_bundle.standardized_site_definition: One identical CLEAR-ATS STI retrofit BOM reference-site equivalent from the frozen STI unit ledger; it is not an observed intersection, controller, ownership-complete inventory, or infrastructure-density estimate.
comparative_reference_bundle.combined_reporting_unit: one author-defined synthetic reference bundle: 1,000,000 registered automobiles plus 1,000 standardized reference-site equivalents
comparative_reference_bundle.reason: Ownership-complete statewide signal inventories do not exist on a comparable national basis. CA/OH absolute registered-scope case studies remain separate.

common_activity.post_2050: hold each bundle at its 2050 activity multiplier

common_electrification.initial_value: DOE AFDC 2025 all-light-duty BEV share proxy; denominator and vintage differ from FHWA 2024 registered automobiles
common_electrification.path_applies_to: electric share of each newly added CAV cohort, not total CAV stock; the stock share emerges from cohort turnover
common_electrification.base_year_compatibility: The imported cohort kernel requires a 2024 anchor. The AFDC 2025 proxy is repeated at 2024 only for the zero-stock compatibility cohort; the first nonzero 2025 cohort uses the unadvanced AFDC 2025 proxy.

common_grid.initial_value: EPA eGRID2023 revision-2 state total-output direct-CO2 rate used as a 2024 model-year proxy
common_grid.resource_share_rule: Raw eGRID resource shares remain descriptive context only. National emissions use the total-output intensity directly, avoiding unstable fossil-block reconstruction in near-zero or negative net-generation shares.

common_engineering.weather_note: No one-station-per-state rural weather expansion; neutral response is held across all national bundles.

estimands.carrier_input: annual operational ATS-incremental carrier input for the normalized reference bundle; propulsion and conventional signal-core energy excluded
estimands.direct_co2: scope-matched operational direct CO2: eGRID state total-output attributional electricity CO2 plus EPA gasoline tailpipe CO2; upstream, non-CO2 and embodied terms excluded
estimands.turning: first year after which every annual direct-CO2 step through 2075 is non-increasing, with at least five subsequent modeled years; otherwise right-censored
estimands.turning_tolerance_interpretation: absolute floating-point equality guard for an author-defined fixed-size synthetic bundle; effectively exact at the modeled scale, not scientific uncertainty
estimands.claim_boundary: deterministic comparative scenarios, not empirical forecasts, causal policy effects, city or urban-rural estimands, carbon-neutrality dates, or cumulative payback dates
